literal.prompt: Работа какого органа создаёт пульсовую волну, которую можно почувствовать на запястье?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The prompt asks which organ creates the pulse wave felt at the wrist. BHF says the heart’s pumping produces the pulse (L137-L140) and that every heartbeat creates a pressure wave in arteries that can be felt near the skin (L145-L148). OpenStax independently describes blood being ejected by each heart contraction (19.1 L33-L34). The four options are all organs in the same genitive construction. The source-supported alternative notes give plausible nearby physiological context, but only the heart creates the pressure wave measured as pulse.
literalGroups.locator: BHF booklet lines 137-148 (the heart pump creates the palpable pulse pressure wave); OpenStax 19.1 L33-L34 (blood ejected by heart contraction). The distractors are same-category named organs; the supplied source-backed notes make each relevant yet distinguishable. BHF L145-L148 establishes heart as the unique wave source.

literalGroups.literal: При каждом ударе сердца в артериях возникает волна давления. Там, где артерии проходят близко к коже, эту волну можно почувствовать как пульс.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The first sentence states the source mechanism: every heartbeat creates a pressure wave as blood flows along arteries. The second sentence explains why the wave can be felt at the wrist, where an artery runs close to the skin. The BHF page states this directly at L145-L148.
literalGroups.locator: BHF booklet L137-L148: heart pumping produces a pulse; every heartbeat creates a pressure wave along arteries, felt as a pulse where arteries are near the skin.

literalGroups.literal: Кровь к желудку поступает по левой и правой желудочным артериям.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax states that the celiac trunk gives rise to the left gastric artery and the common hepatic artery gives rise to the right gastric artery, both supplying blood to the stomach (L146, L163-L168). This is a concrete circulation fact about this distractor.

literalGroups.literal: Печень вырабатывает желчь, которая помогает эмульгировать жиры в тонкой кишке.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax says the liver produces and exports bile to the duodenum (L31); bile emulsifies lipid globules in the small intestine (L52-L54). This is a concrete additional digestive function of the distractor.

literalGroups.literal: Повышенная активность щитовидной железы может сопровождаться учащённым сердцебиением.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The BHF booklet identifies an overactive thyroid as a possible cause of sinus tachycardia (L212-L215). This makes the option plausible because it can affect heart rate, while the preceding pulse definition identifies the heart as the source of the pressure wave.

literalGroups.literal: В покое частота сердечных сокращений взрослого обычно составляет 60–100 ударов в минуту.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The BHF booklet gives a resting adult heart-rate range of 60-100 beats per minute (L163-L164). This is a useful fact about the correct option, beyond the prompt and key.

absoluteDifficulty.ground: The heart-pulse link is common adult body knowledge and the prompt asks for a direct one-step association. The four options are familiar organs; thyroid is especially plausible because its overactivity can accelerate heart rate, but the pulse pressure wave itself is produced by heart pumping.
